The '''Juhani''' was one of the [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that was notable for being less [[Cat/Legends|cat]]-like than the baseline Cathar, a trait that it had in common with the [[Myr Rho]].<ref name="Planet Hoppers">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/PHCathar|series=Planet Hoppers|text=Cathar}}</ref>
